config.install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/Jerry-AI-Original-Tanim-Boss
./scripts/setup-cloud.sh
source scripts/cloud-env.sh
./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest
python3 scripts/verify-foundation-apk.py
config.start_skill: Use the existing /workspace/Jerry-AI-Original-Tanim-Boss checkout; every task is isolated, so do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Leave old Jerry, Maya, and Zoya repositories untouched. In each Android build shell, cd to this checkout and source scripts/cloud-env.sh to activate Java 17, the Android SDK and proxy/CA settings. If missing, run scripts/setup-cloud.sh first. Run ./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest and python3 scripts/verify-foundation-apk.py. No cloud service must run; the output is app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk. Before device tests use adb devices; connectedDebugAndroidTest requires an authorized connected device/emulator. Compiled instrumentation tests are not executed tests. Read docs/VALIDATION.md and docs/DEVICE_TESTING.md; Gemini/background voice and full integrations are not implemented. The 0.2.0 confirmed-actions layer requires explicit user/device consent; never run phone actions as part of cloud setup. Do not push, merge, publish or release without authorization. Never put credentials in source, APKs, logs or backups.
